newsitem.title: USA: Auto sales in U.S. off 12.7 pct June 11-20 - CNW.
newsitem.headline: Auto sales in U.S. off 12.7 pct June 11-20 - CNW.

text.p: Auto sales in the United States fell 12.7 percent in the 10-day period June 11-20 compared with the same period a year ago, according to a report by CNW Marketing/Research.
During the survey period, sales of domestic vehicles slumped 12.8 percent, and U.S. sales of imports sank 12.2 percent.
Domestic car sales fell 15.7 percent, to 153,626 vehicles from 182,219, CNW said. Domestic truck sales fell 10.0 percent, to 170,682 from 189,583, it said.
Import car sales declined 12.8 percent to 46,268, and import truck sales fell 9.1 percent to 9,256, the report said.
Year-to-date, vehicle sales in the United States were 7,161,727, off 1.8 percent from the same period of 1996, according to CNW.
